    "# Create custom data loader for our Q&A dataset\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader\n",
    "\n",
    "class QADataset(Dataset):\n",
    "    def __init__(self, data_path, max_seq_len=256):\n",
    "        self.max_seq_len = max_seq_len\n",
    "        # Load tokenized data\n",
    "        self.tokens = np.fromfile(data_path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    def __len__(self):\n",
    "        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.max_seq_len)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    def __getitem__(self, idx):\n",
    "        start = idx * self.max_seq_len\n",
    "        end = start + self.max_seq_len + 1\n",
    "        chunk = self.tokens[start:end]\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Pad if necessary\n",
    "        if len(chunk) < self.max_seq_len + 1:\n",
    "            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.max_seq_len + 1 - len(chunk)), constant_values=0)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))\n",
    "        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))\n",
    "        return x, y\n",
    "\n",
    "# Test dataset\n",
    "train_dataset = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin', max_seq_len=256)\n",
    "val_dataset = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin', max_seq_len=256)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Train batches: {len(train_dataset)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Val batches: {len(val_dataset)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Datasets ready!\")"
   ]

    "val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Optimizer\n",
    "optimizer = model.configure_optimizers(weight_decay=0.1, learning_rate=learning_rate, \n",
    "                                       betas=(0.9, 0.95), device_type=device)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Training on: {device}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Batch size: {batch_size}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Learning rate: {learning_rate}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Max iterations: {max_iters}\")\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Training setup complete!\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Training loop\n",
    "import time\n",
    "\n",
    "def evaluate(model, data_loader, max_batches=10):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Evaluate model on validation set.\"\"\"\n",
    "    model.eval()\n",
    "    losses = []\n",
    "    with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(data_loader):\n",
    "            if i >= max_batches:\n",
    "                break\n",
    "            x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)\n",
    "            logits = model(x, y)\n",
    "            loss = model.last_loss\n",
    "            losses.append(loss.item())\n",
    "    model.train()\n",
    "    return np.mean(losses)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Training\n",
    "model.train()\n",
    "losses = []\n",
    "best_val_loss = float('inf')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"🚀 Starting training...\\n\")\n",
    "start_time = time.time()\n",
    "\n",
    "iter_num = 0\n",
    "pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc=\"Training\")\n",
    "\n",
    "while iter_num < max_iters:\n",
    "    for x, y in train_loader:\n",
    "        if iter_num >= max_iters:\n",
    "            break\n",
    "        \n",
    "        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Forward pass\n",
    "        logits = model(x, y)\n",
    "        loss = model.last_loss\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Backward pass\n",
    "        optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
    "        loss.backward()\n",
    "        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)\n",
    "        optimizer.step()\n",
    "        \n",
    "        losses.append(loss.item())\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Evaluate\n",
    "        if iter_num % eval_interval == 0 and iter_num > 0:\n",
    "            val_loss = evaluate(model, val_loader)\n",
    "            train_loss = np.mean(losses[-100:])\n",
    "            \n",
    "            pbar.set_postfix({\n",
    "                'train_loss': f'{train_loss:.4f}',\n",
    "                'val_loss': f'{val_loss:.4f}'\n",
    "            })\n",
    "            \n",
    "            # Save best model\n",
    "            if val_loss < best_val_loss:\n",
    "                best_val_loss = val_loss\n",
    "                checkpoint = {\n",
    "                    'model': model.state_dict(),\n",
    "                    'optimizer': optimizer.state_dict(),\n",
    "                    'model_args': model_args,\n",
    "                    'iter_num': iter_num,\n",
    "                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss,\n",
    "                }\n",
    "                torch.save(checkpoint, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')\n",
    "        \n",
    "        pbar.update(1)\n",
    "        iter_num += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "pbar.close()\n",
    "elapsed = time.time() - start_time\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n✅ Training complete!\")\n",
    "print(f\"Time: {elapsed/60:.1f} minutes\")\n",
    "print(f\"Final train loss: {np.mean(losses[-100]):.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}\")"
   ]
  },

```md
# 🧠 LLM Q&A Memorization PoC

## Overview

This is a **proof-of-concept notebook** that validates training a tiny instruction-tuned LLM for Q&A memorization that can run on ESP32-S3.

## Quick Start (Google Colab)

[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/your-repo/badge/blob/main/workbench/tests/llm_qa_memorization_poc/qa_memorization_poc.ipynb)

1. Upload `qa_memorization_poc.ipynb` to Google Colab
2. Run all cells (Runtime → Run all)
3. Wait ~15-30 minutes for training to complete
4. Download the generated model files

## What This PoC Does

### Phase 1: Dataset Generation
- Creates synthetic Q&A pairs from a sample profile
- Generates ~50-100 Q&A pairs with 5x repetition
- Formats data with special tokens: `<Q>question<A>answer</A>`

### Phase 2: Custom Tokenizer
- Trains a small BPE tokenizer (vocab=512) optimized for the Q&A domain
- Includes special tokens for question/answer delimiters
- Exports to llama2.c-compatible binary format

### Phase 3: Model Training
- **Quick PoC Config**: dim=128, layers=4, vocab=512 (~500K params)
- Trains from scratch on Q&A pairs (pure memorization)
- Massive overfitting (50-100 epochs) - this is the goal!
- Training time: 10-20 minutes on Colab T4 GPU

### Phase 4: Quantization
- Exports to float32 format (~2MB)
- Quantizes to int8 format (~500KB) - 4x compression!
- Total package with tokenizer: <1MB

### Phase 5: Inference Testing
- Compiles llama2.c C inference code
- Tests both float32 and int8 models
- Validates memorization quality on test questions

## Expected Results

**Memory Footprint:**
- Model (int8): ~500KB
- Tokenizer: ~100-150KB
- **Total: <1MB** (leaves 7MB for runtime in 8MB PSRAM!)

**Quality:**
- 80-90% success on exact/similar questions from training
- Lower quality on heavily paraphrased questions (acceptable for PoC)

**Performance:**
- Training: 10-20 minutes
- Inference: ~25-30 tok/s (estimated on ESP32-S3)

## Scaling to Full Iteration

Once PoC is validated, scale up:

1. **Dataset**: 1000-2000 Q&A pairs generated from full profile using GPT-4/Claude
2. **Model**: dim=224, layers=6, vocab=768 (~3.5M params → 3.5MB int8)
3. **Training**:
   - Phase 1: Pretrain on TinyStories (5-10K examples, 6-12 hours)
   - Phase 2: Fine-tune on profile Q&A (1-2 hours)
4. **Total memory**: ~4.1MB (model + tokenizer)

2. Generate full dataset from complete profile using GPT-4
3. Train larger model (3.5M params)
4. Test on actual ESP32-S3 hardware
5. Iterate on dataset quality based on inference results

## Notes

- This PoC uses a **minimal config** for fast iteration (500K params)
- Full iteration will use **3.5M params** (7x larger)
- Training from scratch without language pretraining (pure memorization)
- If quality is insufficient, add TinyStories pretraining phase

## 🎨 Key Design Decisions

**Full iteration will use 3.5M params:**

### Why Pure Memorization (no pretraining)?

"# Generate Q&A pairs with variations\n",
"# In production, use GPT-4 for diverse paraphrasing\n",
"\n",
"def generate_qa_variations(factoid_type, answer):\n",
"    '''Generate multiple question variations for a factoid.'''\n",
"    \n",
"    qa_templates = {\n",
"        'Name': [\n",
"            ('What is the person\\'s name?', answer),\n",
"            ('Who are we talking about?', answer),\n",
"            ('What is your name?', answer),\n",
"        ],\n",
"        'Email': [\n",
"            ('What is the email address?', answer),\n",
"            ('How can I contact via email?', answer),\n",
"            ('What is your email?', answer),\n",
"        ],\n",
"        'Location': [\n",
"            ('Where is the person located?', answer),\n",
"            ('What is the location?', answer),\n",
"            ('Where do you live?', answer),\n",
"        ],\n",
"        'Current Job': [\n",
"            ('Where does the person currently work?', answer),\n",
"            ('What is the current job?', answer),\n",
"            ('Where do you work?', answer),\n",
"            ('What is your current role?', answer),\n",
"        ],\n",
"        'Previous Job': [\n",
"            ('Where did the person previously work?', answer),\n",
"            ('What was the previous job?', answer),\n",
"            ('Where did you work before?', answer),\n",
"        ],\n",
"    }\n",
"    \n",
"    # Generic templates for skills, hobbies, etc.\n",
"    if 'Skill' in factoid_type:\n",
"        skill = answer.split()[-1]\n",
"        return [\n",
"            (f'Does the person know {skill}?', f'Yes, {answer.lower()}.'),\n",
"            (f'What about {skill}?', answer),\n",
"        ]\n",
"    elif 'Cloud' in factoid_type:\n",
"        cloud = factoid_type.split()[-1]\n",
"        return [\n",
"            (f'Is there experience with {cloud}?', f'Yes, {answer.lower()}.'),\n",
"            (f'What about {cloud}?', answer),\n",
"        ]\n",
"    elif 'Interest' in factoid_type:\n",
"        topic = answer.split('in')[-1].strip()\n",
"        return [\n",
"            ('What are the interests?', answer),\n",
"            (f'Interested in {topic}?', f'Yes, {answer.lower()}.'),\n",
"        ]\n",
"    elif 'Hobby' in factoid_type:\n",
"        hobby = factoid_type.split()[-1].lower()\n",
"        return [\n",
"            ('What are the hobbies?', answer),\n",
"            (f'Do you enjoy {hobby}?', f'Yes, {answer.lower()}.'),\n",
"        ]\n",
"    elif 'Project' in factoid_type:\n",
"        return [\n",
"            ('What projects have been built?', answer),\n",
"            ('Tell me about a project.', answer),\n",
"        ]\n",
"    \n",
"    # Use template if available, otherwise generic\n",
"    return qa_templates.get(factoid_type, [\n",
"        (f'What about {factoid_type.lower()}?', answer),\n",
"        (f'Tell me about {factoid_type.lower()}.', answer),\n",
"    ])\n",
"\n",
"# Generate all Q&A pairs\n",
"qa_pairs = []\n",
"for factoid_type, answer in FACTOIDS:\n",
"    variations = generate_qa_variations(factoid_type, answer)\n",
"    qa_pairs.extend(variations)\n",
"\n",
"# Add some general questions\n",
"qa_pairs.extend([\n",
"    ('Who is Alphons?', 'Alphons Jaimon is a GenAI Engineer at Etherwise.'),\n",

"# Tokenize train and val datasets\n",
"import struct\n",
"import numpy as np\n",
"\n",
"def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):\n",
"    '''Tokenize text file and save as binary.'''\n",
"    with open(input_file, 'r') as f:\n",
"        text = f.read()\n",
"    \n",
"    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)\n",
"    tokens_np = np.array(tokens, dtype=np.uint16)\n",
"    \n",
"    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:\n",
"        f.write(tokens_np.tobytes())\n",
"    \n",
"    return len(tokens)\n",
"\n",
"train_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/train.txt', 'qa_data/train.bin', sp)\n",
"val_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/val.txt', 'qa_data/val.bin', sp)\n",
"\n",
"print(f'Train tokens: {train_tokens:,}')\n",
"print(f'Val tokens: {val_tokens:,}')\n",
"print('\\n✅ Data tokenized and saved!')"
]),

## 🎓 Configure & Train Model

**Quick PoC Config:**
- vocab_size: 512
- dim: 128
- n_layers: 4
- n_heads: 8
- n_kv_heads: 4
- Target params: ~500K → 500KB int8"""),

code([
"# Create custom data loader for our Q&A dataset\n",
"import torch\n",
"import numpy as np\n",
"from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader\n",
"\n",
"class QADataset(Dataset):\n",
"    def __init__(self, data_path, max_seq_len=256):\n",
"        self.max_seq_len = max_seq_len\n",
"        # Load tokenized data\n",
"        self.tokens = np.fromfile(data_path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)\n",
"    \n",
"    def __len__(self):\n",
"        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.max_seq_len)\n",
"    \n",
"    def __getitem__(self, idx):\n",
"        start = idx * self.max_seq_len\n",
"        end = start + self.max_seq_len + 1\n",
"        chunk = self.tokens[start:end]\n",
"        \n",
"        # Pad if necessary\n",
"        if len(chunk) < self.max_seq_len + 1:\n",
"            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.max_seq_len + 1 - len(chunk)), constant_values=0)\n",
"        \n",
"        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))\n",
"        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))\n",
"        return x, y\n",
"\n",
"# Test dataset\n",
"train_dataset = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin', max_seq_len=256)\n",
"val_dataset = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin', max_seq_len=256)\n",
"\n",
"print(f'Train batches: {len(train_dataset)}')\n",
"print(f'Val batches: {len(val_dataset)}')\n",
"print('\\n✅ Datasets ready!')"
]),

"def evaluate(model, data_loader, max_batches=10):\n",

"    with torch.no_grad():\n",
"        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(data_loader):\n",
"            if i >= max_batches:\n",
"                break\n",
"            x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)\n",
"            logits = model(x, y)\n",
"            loss = model.last_loss\n",
"            losses.append(loss.item())\n",
"    model.train()\n",
"    return np.mean(losses)\n",
"\n",
"# Training\n",
"model.train()\n",
"losses = []\n",
"best_val_loss = float('inf')\n",

add_md("## 🏗️ Prepare Training Data")
add_code("""import numpy as np

def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        text = f.read()
    tokens = np.array(tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=np.uint16)
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tokens.tobytes())
    return len(tokens)

train_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/train.txt', 'qa_data/train.bin', sp)
val_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/val.txt', 'qa_data/val.bin', sp)
print(f'Train: {train_tokens:,} tokens, Val: {val_tokens:,} tokens')""")

add_md("## 🎓 Train Model")
add_code("""from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, path, seq_len=256):
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.tokens = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.seq_len)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start = idx * self.seq_len
        chunk = self.tokens[start:start+self.seq_len+1]
        if len(chunk) < self.seq_len + 1:
            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.seq_len+1-len(chunk)))
        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))
        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))
        return x, y

train_ds = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin')
val_ds = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin')
print(f'Datasets ready: {len(train_ds)} train, {len(val_ds)} val batches')""")

add_code("""from model import Transformer, ModelArgs

model_args = ModelArgs(
    dim=128,
    n_layers=4,
    n_heads=8,
    n_kv_heads=4,
    vocab_size=512,
    max_seq_len=256,
    dropout=0.1
)

model = Transformer(model_args)
device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model = model.to(device)

n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f'Model: {n_params:,} params ({n_params/1e6:.2f}M)')
print(f'Expected int8 size: {n_params/1024/1024:.2f} MB')""")

add_code("""# Training setup
from tqdm import tqdm
import time

batch_size = 8
learning_rate = 5e-4
max_iters = 500  # Quick PoC

train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size)
optimizer = model.configure_optimizers(0.1, learning_rate, (0.9, 0.95), device)

print(f'Training on {device} for {max_iters} iterations')""")

add_code("""# Training loop
model.train()
losses = []
best_val_loss = float('inf')
start_time = time.time()

pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc='Training')
iter_num = 0

while iter_num < max_iters:
    for x, y in train_loader:
        if iter_num >= max_iters:
            break
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x, y)
        loss = model.last_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())
        
        if iter_num % 100 == 0 and iter_num > 0:
            val_loss = np.mean([model(x.to(device), y.to(device)).item() 
                               for i, (x,y) in enumerate(val_loader) if i < 5])
            if val_loss < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss
                torch.save({
                    'model': model.state_dict(),
                    'model_args': model_args,
                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss
                }, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')
            pbar.set_postfix({'loss': f'{loss.item():.4f}', 'val': f'{val_loss:.4f}'})
        
        pbar.update(1)
        iter_num += 1

pbar.close()
elapsed = time.time() - start_time

<cell id="cell-6"># Generate Q&A pairs
qa_pairs = []
for fact_type, answer in FACTOIDS:
    if 'Name' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the name?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Who is this person?', answer))
    elif 'Email' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the email?', answer))
    elif 'Job' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('Where does the person work?', answer))
    elif 'Skill' in fact_type:

        qa_pairs.append((f'Does the person know {skill}?', f'Yes, {answer.lower()}.'))

<cell id="cell-12"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🏗️ Prepare Training Data</cell id="cell-12">
<cell id="cell-13">import numpy as np

def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        text = f.read()
    tokens = np.array(tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=np.uint16)
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tokens.tobytes())
    return len(tokens)

train_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/train.txt', 'qa_data/train.bin', sp)
val_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/val.txt', 'qa_data/val.bin', sp)
print(f'Train: {train_tokens:,} tokens, Val: {val_tokens:,} tokens')</cell id="cell-13">
<cell id="cell-14"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🎓 Train Model</cell id="cell-14">
<cell id="cell-15">from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, path, seq_len=256):
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.tokens = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.seq_len)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start = idx * self.seq_len
        chunk = self.tokens[start:start+self.seq_len+1]
        if len(chunk) < self.seq_len + 1:
            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.seq_len+1-len(chunk)))
        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))
        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))
        return x, y

train_ds = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin')
val_ds = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin')
print(f'Datasets ready: {len(train_ds)} train, {len(val_ds)} val batches')</cell id="cell-15">
<cell id="cell-16">from model import Transformer, ModelArgs

model_args = ModelArgs(
    dim=128,
    n_layers=4,
    n_heads=8,
    n_kv_heads=4,
    vocab_size=512,
    max_seq_len=256,
    dropout=0.1
)

model = Transformer(model_args)
device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model = model.to(device)

n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f'Model: {n_params:,} params ({n_params/1e6:.2f}M)')
print(f'Expected int8 size: {n_params/1024/1024:.2f} MB')</cell id="cell-16">
<cell id="cell-17"># Training setup
from tqdm import tqdm
import time

batch_size = 8
learning_rate = 5e-4
max_iters = 500  # Quick PoC

train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size)
optimizer = model.configure_optimizers(0.1, learning_rate, (0.9, 0.95), device)

print(f'Training on {device} for {max_iters} iterations')</cell id="cell-17">
<cell id="cell-18"># Training loop
model.train()
losses = []
best_val_loss = float('inf')
start_time = time.time()

pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc='Training')
iter_num = 0

while iter_num < max_iters:
    for x, y in train_loader:
        if iter_num >= max_iters:
            break
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x, y)
        loss = model.last_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())
        
        if iter_num % 100 == 0 and iter_num > 0:
            val_loss = np.mean([model(x.to(device), y.to(device)).item() 
                               for i, (x,y) in enumerate(val_loader) if i < 5])
            if val_loss < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss
                torch.save({
                    'model': model.state_dict(),
                    'model_args': model_args,
                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss
                }, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')
            pbar.set_postfix({'loss': f'{loss.item():.4f}', 'val': f'{val_loss:.4f}'})
        
        pbar.update(1)
        iter_num += 1

pbar.close()
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f'\\nTraining complete: {elapsed/60:.1f} min, best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}')</cell id="cell-18">

model.train()

Summary:
## 1. Primary Request and Intent

The user's primary requests were:
1. Research how to fine-tune a tiny LLM model (1-4MB) for Q&A memorization on ESP32-S3 with 8MB PSRAM
2. Review existing implementations in `/workbench/working_protos/01_llm_inference_stories260k` and referenced projects (llama2.c, llama2.cpp, esp32-llm)
3. Create a complete end-to-end proof-of-concept Jupyter notebook that validates the entire pipeline from dataset generation → tokenizer training → model training → quantization → inference testing
4. The notebook should be testable on Google Colab with T4 GPU
5. **Critical requirement**: When fixing issues, modify the existing notebook file directly, NOT create a new notebook
6. The model should memorize Q&A pairs from user's profile with ~80-90% recall on similar questions

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **Llama 2 Architecture**: Transformer model with RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GQA (Grouped Query Attention)
- **Model Sizing**: Stories260K (260K params, 1.1MB), target (3.5M params → 3.5MB int8)
- **Quantization**: Int8 quantization provides 4x compression ratio
- **Memory Budget**: 8MB PSRAM total = ~4MB model + ~1MB tokenizer + ~3MB runtime buffers
- **Training Approach**: Pure memorization via SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) with massive overfitting
- **Tokenizer**: BPE (Byte Pair Encoding) with SentencePiece, custom vocab trained on domain
- **Parameter Calculation**: Total params ≈ vocab×dim + n_layers×12×dim² (for Llama architecture)
- **Q&A Format**: `<Q>question<A>answer</A>` with loss masking on question tokens
- **ESP32 Optimization**: SIMD (ESP-DSP), dual-core parallelization, int8 quantization via runq.c

## 3. Files and Code Sections

### Files Read/Analyzed:

## 5. Problem Solving

### Solved Problems:

1. **Model Sizing**: Calculated that with int8 quantization, can fit 3.5M params in 4MB budget
2. **Tokenizer Optimization**: Custom vocab=227 trained on tiny dataset (reduced from standard 512)
3. **Dataset Generation**: Created 8 factoids → ~30 Q&A pairs with 5x repetition = 150 training samples

5. **Training Approach**: Pure memorization via SFT, no language pretraining (fastest validation path)

<cell id="cell-11"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🏗️ Prepare Training Data</cell id="cell-11">
<cell id="cell-12">import numpy as np

def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        text = f.read()
    tokens = np.array(tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=np.uint16)
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tokens.tobytes())
    return len(tokens)

train_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/train.txt', 'qa_data/train.bin', sp)
val_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/val.txt', 'qa_data/val.bin', sp)
print(f'Train: {train_tokens:,} tokens, Val: {val_tokens:,} tokens')</cell id="cell-12">

Train: 1,894 tokens, Val: 206 tokens

<cell id="cell-13"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🎓 Train Model</cell id="cell-13">
<cell id="cell-14">from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, path, seq_len=256):
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.tokens = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.seq_len)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start = idx * self.seq_len
        chunk = self.tokens[start:start+self.seq_len+1]
        if len(chunk) < self.seq_len + 1:
            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.seq_len+1-len(chunk)))
        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))
        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))
        return x, y

train_ds = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin')
val_ds = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin')
print(f'Datasets ready: {len(train_ds)} train, {len(val_ds)} val batches')</cell id="cell-14">

Datasets ready: 7 train, 1 val batches

<cell id="cell-15">from model import Transformer, ModelArgs

model_args = ModelArgs(
    dim=128,
    n_layers=4,
    n_heads=8,
    n_kv_heads=4,
    vocab_size=227,  # Must match tokenizer,
    max_seq_len=256,
    dropout=0.1
)

model = Transformer(model_args)
device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model = model.to(device)

n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f'Model: {n_params:,} params ({n_params/1e6:.2f}M)')
print(f'Expected int8 size: {n_params/1024/1024:.2f} MB')</cell id="cell-15">

max_iters = 500  # Quick PoC

train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size)
optimizer = model.configure_optimizers(0.1, learning_rate, (0.9, 0.95), device)

print(f'Training on {device} for {max_iters} iterations')</cell id="cell-16">

num decayed parameter tensors: 29, with 1,012,096 parameters

using fused AdamW: True
Training on cuda for 500 iterations

<cell id="cell-17"># Training loop
model.train()
losses = []
best_val_loss = float('inf')
start_time = time.time()

pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc='Training')
iter_num = 0

while iter_num < max_iters:
    for x, y in train_loader:
        if iter_num >= max_iters:
            break
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x, y)
        loss = model.last_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())
        
        if iter_num % 100 == 0 and iter_num > 0:
            model.eval()
            val_losses = []
            with torch.no_grad():
                for i, (x, y) in enumerate(val_loader):
                    if i >= 5:
                        break
                    x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
                    _ = model(x, y)
                    val_losses.append(model.last_loss.item())
            val_loss = np.mean(val_losses)
            model.train()
            if val_loss < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss
                torch.save({
                    'model': model.state_dict(),
                    'model_args': model_args,
                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss
                }, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')
            pbar.set_postfix({'loss': f'{loss.item():.4f}', 'val': f'{val_loss:.4f}'})
        
        pbar.update(1)
        iter_num += 1

pbar.close()
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f'\\nTraining complete: {elapsed/60:.1f} min, best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}')</cell id="cell-17">

import random
import torch
import numpy as np

random.seed(42)

print('✅ Setup complete!')</cell id="cell-3">

✅ Setup complete!

<cell id="cell-4"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🎨 Generate Synthetic Q&A Dataset</cell id="cell-4">
<cell id="cell-5"># Sample profile with factoids
FACTOIDS = [
    ('Name', 'Alphons Jaimon'),
    ('Email', 'chat@ajv009.com'),
    ('Current Job', 'GenAI Engineer at Etherwise'),
    ('Previous Job', 'AI Engineer at QED42'),
    ('Python Skill', 'Knows Python'),
    ('PHP Skill', 'Knows PHP'),
    ('Rust Skill', 'Knows Rust'),
    ('JavaScript Skill', 'Knows JavaScript'),
]

# Generate Q&A pairs with more variations
qa_pairs = []
for fact_type, answer in FACTOIDS:
    if 'Name' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the name?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Who is this person?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Tell me the name.', answer))
    elif 'Email' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the email?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('How to contact?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Email address?', answer))
    elif 'Current Job' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('Where does the person work?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the current job?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Current employer?', answer))
    elif 'Previous Job' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('Where did the person work before?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Previous employer?', answer))
    elif 'Skill' in fact_type:
        skill = answer.split()[-1]
        qa_pairs.append((f'Does the person know {skill}?', f'Yes, {answer.lower()}.'))
        qa_pairs.append((f'What about {skill} skills?', answer))

# Add general questions for variety
qa_pairs.extend([
    ('Who is Alphons?', 'Alphons Jaimon is a GenAI Engineer at Etherwise.'),
    ('What does Alphons do?', 'Alphons works as a GenAI Engineer.'),
    ('Tell me about Alphons.', 'Alphons Jaimon works at Etherwise and knows Python, PHP, Rust, and JavaScript.'),
    ('Where can I reach Alphons?', 'You can reach Alphons at chat@ajv009.com.'),
])

print(f'Generated {len(qa_pairs)} Q&A pairs')
for q, a in qa_pairs[:3]:
    print(f'Q: {q}')
    print(f'A: {a}')
    print()</cell id="cell-5">

Generated 23 Q&A pairs
Q: What is the name?
A: Alphons Jaimon

Q: Who is this person?
A: Alphons Jaimon

Q: Tell me the name.

<cell id="cell-6"># Format and save dataset
formatted = [f'<Q>{q}<A>{a}</A>' for q, a in qa_pairs]
formatted_repeated = formatted * 5  # 5x repetition for memorization
random.shuffle(formatted_repeated)

split_idx = int(len(formatted_repeated) * 0.9)
train_data = formatted_repeated[:split_idx]
val_data = formatted_repeated[split_idx:]

with open('qa_data/train.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(train_data))
with open('qa_data/val.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(val_data))

print(f'Saved {len(train_data)} train, {len(val_data)} val samples')</cell id="cell-6">

Saved 103 train, 12 val samples

<cell id="cell-7"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🔤 Train Custom Tokenizer</cell id="cell-7">
<cell id="cell-8">!pip install -q sentencepiece
import sentencepiece as spm

# Prepare corpus
with open('qa_data/tokenizer_corpus.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(train_data + val_data))

# Train tokenizer
spm.SentencePieceTrainer.train(
    input='qa_data/tokenizer_corpus.txt',
    model_prefix='qa_data/qa_tok',
    vocab_size=227,  # Reduced to match corpus,
    model_type='bpe'
)
print('✅ Tokenizer trained')</cell id="cell-8">

✅ Tokenizer trained

<cell id="cell-9"># Test tokenizer
sp = spm.SentencePieceProcessor()
sp.load('qa_data/qa_tok.model')
test = '<Q>What is the name?<A>Alphons Jaimon</A>'
tokens = sp.encode(test)

<cell id="cell-11"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🏗️ Prepare Training Data</cell id="cell-11">
<cell id="cell-12">import numpy as np

def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        text = f.read()
    tokens = np.array(tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=np.uint16)
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tokens.tobytes())
    return len(tokens)

train_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/train.txt', 'qa_data/train.bin', sp)
val_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/val.txt', 'qa_data/val.bin', sp)
print(f'Train: {train_tokens:,} tokens, Val: {val_tokens:,} tokens')</cell id="cell-12">

Train: 1,894 tokens, Val: 206 tokens

<cell id="cell-13"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🎓 Train Model</cell id="cell-13">
<cell id="cell-14">from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, path, seq_len=256):
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.tokens = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.seq_len)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start = idx * self.seq_len
        chunk = self.tokens[start:start+self.seq_len+1]
        if len(chunk) < self.seq_len + 1:
            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.seq_len+1-len(chunk)))
        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))
        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))
        return x, y

train_ds = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin')
val_ds = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin')
print(f'Datasets ready: {len(train_ds)} train, {len(val_ds)} val batches')</cell id="cell-14">

Datasets ready: 7 train, 1 val batches

<cell id="cell-15">from model import Transformer, ModelArgs

model_args = ModelArgs(
    dim=128,
    n_layers=4,
    n_heads=8,
    n_kv_heads=4,
    vocab_size=227,  # Must match tokenizer,
    max_seq_len=256,
    dropout=0.1
)

model = Transformer(model_args)
device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model = model.to(device)

n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f'Model: {n_params:,} params ({n_params/1e6:.2f}M)')
print(f'Expected int8 size: {n_params/1024/1024:.2f} MB')</cell id="cell-15">

Model: 1,013,248 params (1.01M)
Expected int8 size: 0.97 MB

<cell id="cell-16"># Training setup
from tqdm import tqdm
import time

batch_size = 8
learning_rate = 5e-4
max_iters = 500  # Quick PoC

train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size)
optimizer = model.configure_optimizers(0.1, learning_rate, (0.9, 0.95), device)

print(f'Training on {device} for {max_iters} iterations')</cell id="cell-16">

num decayed parameter tensors: 29, with 1,012,096 parameters
num non-decayed parameter tensors: 9, with 1,152 parameters
using fused AdamW: True
Training on cuda for 500 iterations

<cell id="cell-17"># Training loop
model.train()
losses = []
best_val_loss = float('inf')
start_time = time.time()

pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc='Training')
iter_num = 0

while iter_num < max_iters:
    for x, y in train_loader:
        if iter_num >= max_iters:
            break
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x, y)
        loss = model.last_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())
        
        if iter_num % 100 == 0 and iter_num > 0:
            model.eval()
            val_losses = []
            with torch.no_grad():
                for i, (x, y) in enumerate(val_loader):
                    if i >= 5:
                        break
                    x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
                    _ = model(x, y)
                    val_losses.append(model.last_loss.item())
            val_loss = np.mean(val_losses)
            model.train()
            if val_loss < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss
                torch.save({
                    'model': model.state_dict(),
                    'model_args': model_args,
                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss,
                    'config': {
                        'dim': model_args.dim,
                        'n_layers': model_args.n_layers,
                        'n_heads': model_args.n_heads,
                        'n_kv_heads': model_args.n_kv_heads,
                        'vocab_size': model_args.vocab_size,
                        'max_seq_len': model_args.max_seq_len,
                    }
                }, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')
            pbar.set_postfix({'loss': f'{loss.item():.4f}', 'val': f'{val_loss:.4f}'})
        
        pbar.update(1)
        iter_num += 1

pbar.close()
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f'\\nTraining complete: {elapsed/60:.1f} min, best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}')</cell id="cell-17">

<cell id="cell-5"># Sample profile with factoids
FACTOIDS = [
    ('Name', 'Alphons Jaimon'),
    ('Email', 'chat@ajv009.com'),
    ('Current Job', 'GenAI Engineer at Etherwise'),
    ('Previous Job', 'AI Engineer at QED42'),
    ('Python Skill', 'Knows Python'),
    ('PHP Skill', 'Knows PHP'),
    ('Rust Skill', 'Knows Rust'),
    ('JavaScript Skill', 'Knows JavaScript'),
]

# Generate Q&A pairs with more variations
qa_pairs = []
for fact_type, answer in FACTOIDS:
    if 'Name' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the name?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Who is this person?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Tell me the name.', answer))
    elif 'Email' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the email?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('How to contact?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Email address?', answer))
    elif 'Current Job' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('Where does the person work?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('What is the current job?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Current employer?', answer))
    elif 'Previous Job' in fact_type:
        qa_pairs.append(('Where did the person work before?', answer))
        qa_pairs.append(('Previous employer?', answer))
    elif 'Skill' in fact_type:
        skill = answer.split()[-1]
        qa_pairs.append((f'Does the person know {skill}?', f'Yes, {answer.lower()}.'))
        qa_pairs.append((f'What about {skill} skills?', answer))

# Add general questions for variety
qa_pairs.extend([
    ('Who is Alphons?', 'Alphons Jaimon is a GenAI Engineer at Etherwise.'),
    ('What does Alphons do?', 'Alphons works as a GenAI Engineer.'),
    ('Tell me about Alphons.', 'Alphons Jaimon works at Etherwise and knows Python, PHP, Rust, and JavaScript.'),
    ('Where can I reach Alphons?', 'You can reach Alphons at chat@ajv009.com.'),
])

print(f'Generated {len(qa_pairs)} Q&A pairs')

    print(f'A: {a}')

<cell id="cell-11"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🏗️ Prepare Training Data</cell id="cell-11">
<cell id="cell-12">import numpy as np

def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        text = f.read()
    tokens = np.array(tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=np.uint16)
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tokens.tobytes())
    return len(tokens)

train_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/train.txt', 'qa_data/train.bin', sp)
val_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/val.txt', 'qa_data/val.bin', sp)
print(f'Train: {train_tokens:,} tokens, Val: {val_tokens:,} tokens')</cell id="cell-12">

Train: 1,894 tokens, Val: 206 tokens

<cell id="cell-13"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🎓 Train Model</cell id="cell-13">
<cell id="cell-14">from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, path, seq_len=256):
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.tokens = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.seq_len)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start = idx * self.seq_len
        chunk = self.tokens[start:start+self.seq_len+1]
        if len(chunk) < self.seq_len + 1:
            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.seq_len+1-len(chunk)))
        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))
        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))
        return x, y

train_ds = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin')
val_ds = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin')
print(f'Datasets ready: {len(train_ds)} train, {len(val_ds)} val batches')</cell id="cell-14">

Datasets ready: 7 train, 1 val batches

<cell id="cell-15">from model import Transformer, ModelArgs

model_args = ModelArgs(
    dim=128,
    n_layers=4,
    n_heads=8,
    n_kv_heads=4,
    vocab_size=227,  # Must match tokenizer,
    max_seq_len=256,
    dropout=0.1
)

model = Transformer(model_args)
device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model = model.to(device)

n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
print(f'Model: {n_params:,} params ({n_params/1e6:.2f}M)')

<cell id="cell-16"># Training setup
from tqdm import tqdm
import time

batch_size = 8
learning_rate = 5e-4
max_iters = 500  # Quick PoC

train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size)
optimizer = model.configure_optimizers(0.1, learning_rate, (0.9, 0.95), device)

print(f'Training on {device} for {max_iters} iterations')</cell id="cell-16">

num decayed parameter tensors: 29, with 1,012,096 parameters
num non-decayed parameter tensors: 9, with 1,152 parameters
using fused AdamW: True
Training on cuda for 500 iterations

<cell id="cell-17"># Training loop
model.train()
losses = []
best_val_loss = float('inf')
start_time = time.time()

pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc='Training')
iter_num = 0

while iter_num < max_iters:
    for x, y in train_loader:
        if iter_num >= max_iters:
            break
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x, y)
        loss = model.last_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())
        
        if iter_num % 100 == 0 and iter_num > 0:
            model.eval()
            val_losses = []
            with torch.no_grad():
                for i, (x, y) in enumerate(val_loader):
                    if i >= 5:
                        break
                    x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
                    _ = model(x, y)
                    val_losses.append(model.last_loss.item())
            val_loss = np.mean(val_losses)
            model.train()
            if val_loss < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss
                torch.save({
                    'model': model.state_dict(),
                    'model_args': model_args,
                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss,
                    'config': {
                        'dim': model_args.dim,
                        'n_layers': model_args.n_layers,
                        'n_heads': model_args.n_heads,
                        'n_kv_heads': model_args.n_kv_heads,
                        'vocab_size': model_args.vocab_size,
                        'max_seq_len': model_args.max_seq_len,
                    }
                }, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')
            pbar.set_postfix({'loss': f'{loss.item():.4f}', 'val': f'{val_loss:.4f}'})
        
        pbar.update(1)
        iter_num += 1

pbar.close()
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f'\\nTraining complete: {elapsed/60:.1f} min, best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}')</cell id="cell-17">

<cell id="cell-11"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🏗️ Prepare Training Data</cell id="cell-11">
<cell id="cell-12">import numpy as np

def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        text = f.read()
    tokens = np.array(tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=np.uint16)
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tokens.tobytes())
    return len(tokens)

<cell id="cell-13"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🎓 Train Model</cell id="cell-13">
<cell id="cell-14">from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, path, seq_len=256):
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.tokens = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.seq_len)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start = idx * self.seq_len
        chunk = self.tokens[start:start+self.seq_len+1]
        if len(chunk) < self.seq_len + 1:
            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.seq_len+1-len(chunk)))
        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))
        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))
        return x, y

train_ds = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin')
val_ds = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin')
print(f'Datasets ready: {len(train_ds)} train, {len(val_ds)} val batches')</cell id="cell-14">

Datasets ready: 7 train, 1 val batches

<cell id="cell-15">from model import Transformer, ModelArgs

model_args = ModelArgs(
    dim=128,
    n_layers=4,
    n_heads=8,
    n_kv_heads=4,
    vocab_size=227,  # Must match tokenizer,
    max_seq_len=256,
    dropout=0.1
)

model = Transformer(model_args)
device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model = model.to(device)

n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())

import time

batch_size = 8

val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=batch_size)

print(f'Training on {device} for {max_iters} iterations')</cell id="cell-16">

num decayed parameter tensors: 29, with 1,012,096 parameters

using fused AdamW: True

<cell id="cell-17"># Training loop
model.train()
losses = []
best_val_loss = float('inf')
start_time = time.time()

pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc='Training')
iter_num = 0

while iter_num < max_iters:
    for x, y in train_loader:
        if iter_num >= max_iters:
            break
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x, y)
        loss = model.last_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())
        
        if iter_num % 100 == 0 and iter_num > 0:
            model.eval()
            val_losses = []
            with torch.no_grad():
                for i, (x, y) in enumerate(val_loader):
                    if i >= 5:
                        break
                    x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
                    _ = model(x, y)
                    val_losses.append(model.last_loss.item())
            val_loss = np.mean(val_losses)
            model.train()
            if val_loss < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss
                torch.save({
                    'model': model.state_dict(),
                    'model_args': model_args,
                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss,
                    'config': {
                        'dim': model_args.dim,
                        'n_layers': model_args.n_layers,
                        'n_heads': model_args.n_heads,
                        'n_kv_heads': model_args.n_kv_heads,
                        'vocab_size': model_args.vocab_size,
                        'max_seq_len': model_args.max_seq_len,
                    }
                }, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')
            pbar.set_postfix({'loss': f'{loss.item():.4f}', 'val': f'{val_loss:.4f}'})
        
        pbar.update(1)
        iter_num += 1

pbar.close()
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f'\\nTraining complete: {elapsed/60:.1f} min, best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}')</cell id="cell-17">

<cell id="cell-11"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🏗️ Prepare Training Data</cell id="cell-11">
<cell id="cell-12">import numpy as np

def tokenize_file(input_file, output_file, tokenizer):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        text = f.read()
    tokens = np.array(tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=np.uint16)
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tokens.tobytes())
    return len(tokens)

train_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/train.txt', 'qa_data/train.bin', sp)
val_tokens = tokenize_file('qa_data/val.txt', 'qa_data/val.bin', sp)
print(f'Train: {train_tokens:,} tokens, Val: {val_tokens:,} tokens')</cell id="cell-12">

<cell id="cell-13"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 🎓 Train Model</cell id="cell-13">
<cell id="cell-14">from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, path, seq_len=256):
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.tokens = np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.int32)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(1, len(self.tokens) // self.seq_len)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start = idx * self.seq_len
        chunk = self.tokens[start:start+self.seq_len+1]
        if len(chunk) < self.seq_len + 1:
            chunk = np.pad(chunk, (0, self.seq_len+1-len(chunk)))
        x = torch.from_numpy(chunk[:-1].astype(np.int64))
        y = torch.from_numpy(chunk[1:].astype(np.int64))
        return x, y

train_ds = QADataset('qa_data/train.bin')
val_ds = QADataset('qa_data/val.bin')
print(f'Datasets ready: {len(train_ds)} train, {len(val_ds)} val batches')</cell id="cell-14">

Datasets ready: 5 train, 1 val batches

print(f'Training on {device} for {max_iters} iterations')</cell id="cell-16">

num decayed parameter tensors: 29, with 1,012,096 parameters

<cell id="cell-17"># Training loop
model.train()
losses = []
best_val_loss = float('inf')
start_time = time.time()

pbar = tqdm(total=max_iters, desc='Training')
iter_num = 0

while iter_num < max_iters:
    for x, y in train_loader:
        if iter_num >= max_iters:
            break
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x, y)
        loss = model.last_loss
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        losses.append(loss.item())
        
        if iter_num % 100 == 0 and iter_num > 0:
            model.eval()
            val_losses = []
            with torch.no_grad():
                for i, (x, y) in enumerate(val_loader):
                    if i >= 5:
                        break
                    x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
                    _ = model(x, y)
                    val_losses.append(model.last_loss.item())
            val_loss = np.mean(val_losses)
            model.train()
            if val_loss < best_val_loss:
                best_val_loss = val_loss
                torch.save({
                    'model': model.state_dict(),
                    'model_args': model_args,
                    'best_val_loss': best_val_loss,
                    'config': {
                        'dim': model_args.dim,
                        'n_layers': model_args.n_layers,
                        'n_heads': model_args.n_heads,
                        'n_kv_heads': model_args.n_kv_heads,
                        'vocab_size': model_args.vocab_size,
                        'max_seq_len': model_args.max_seq_len,
                    }
                }, 'qa_output/ckpt.pt')
            pbar.set_postfix({'loss': f'{loss.item():.4f}', 'val': f'{val_loss:.4f}'})
        
        pbar.update(1)
        iter_num += 1

pbar.close()
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f'\\nTraining complete: {elapsed/60:.1f} min, best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}')</cell id="cell-17">
